title: 阻障層與種子層沉積
summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究功能與截面、沉積與連續性、介面與填充、擴散與可靠度；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: functions and sections, deposition and continuity, interfaces and filling, diffusion and reliability. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

steps.title: 估算襯層占用的導電截面

steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：尺度縮小時占比會提高。

steps.instruction:

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：假設矩形溝槽外框 20×40 nm²，襯層只占兩側與底部。厚度 2 nm 時導電截面為 16×38=608 nm²；厚度 3 nm 時為14×37=518 nm²。固定ρ與長度後，電阻比為608/518≈1.174，增加17.4%。但較薄層若有針孔，不能只憑低電阻選用；補上擴散可靠度關卡。
steps.instructionEn:
Estimate conducting area consumed by liners. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Use explicitly hypothetical data for one calculation or classification; retain units, denominators and intermediate results. Finally check your inference against this principle: The fractional occupancy grows as dimensions shrink.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Assume a 20×40 nm² trench with liners on both sides and bottom. At 2 nm thickness, conducting area is 16×38=608 nm²; at 3 nm it is 14×37=518 nm². With fixed ρ and length, resistance ratio is 608/518≈1.174, a 17.4% increase. A thinner layer with pinholes cannot be selected on resistance alone; add diffusion-reliability gates.
steps.observation:

交付 608、518 nm²與17.4%，且不得省略阻障完整性。
steps.observationEn:
The fractional occupancy grows as dimensions shrink. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Report 608 and 518 nm² and 17.4%, retaining barrier-integrity requirements.
